analysis.title: Marketcolour + M&A Basket/Global Macro /Gjensidige / Wart / Alv / Orange / Apple
key_insights: US equities closed higher Monday: SPX +70bps to 7676, NDX +109bps to 29273, RTY +38bps to 2786. 7 of 11 sectors were up, led by Industrials (+1.40%) and Consumer Discretionary (+1.11%), with Communication Services down 1.42%.
Brazil's EWZ fell 20%, its worst session outside of covid, after President Lula won the Brazil election. BRLUSD fell another 9%.

Breadth recovered, showing stabilization in the AI trade: GS Data Center Basket (GSTMTDAT) +2.60% and AI Semis basket (GSCBSMHX) +2.52%. In Europe, EU Defense +2.4% and EU Semis +2.3%. French Banks (GSXEFRBK) +2% on the Moody's relief.

ATSs (dark pools) have gained 2.3% of US equities market share per share and 3.5% on a notional basis since 2024. OTC share gains were +0.1% per share, and OTC lost 2.8% notional share over the same period.
Flow: there are still few signs of offense in AI/Tech. The bounces of the last 2 weeks were mostly driven by the end of high-velocity supply.

M&A basket (GSTRACQN) additions: Abivax, Haleon, Moncler, Burberry, Prada, Swatch Group, Rightmove, Scout24 and Zegona. About 65% of the basket is Industrials, Consumer Discretionary and Healthcare, and about 35% is UK-domiciled.

GS asset allocation stays modestly pro-risk: OW equities for 3m/12m, UW credit for 3m/12m, OW cash for 3m, OW bonds for 12m. AI concerns, Middle East tensions and mid-term elections could sustain near-term volatility, but earnings support, lighter positioning and lower valuations should help equities into year-end.

Global Macro: growth has been unremarkable in 2026, with fiscal easing and the AI boom offsetting energy and tariff drags. The 2027 baseline is a similar pace, with downside risks from higher energy prices, higher bond yields and slower AI investment growth. GS expects fewer rate hikes than priced for most major DM central banks.

Gjensidige: downgrade to Neutral, PT NKK 273 (5% upside). Pricing is expected to normalise as claims inflation moderates, margin expansion becomes more measured, and FY27e-30e EPS is cut by about 2.4% on average.

Wartsila: order growth +45% vs consensus +33%, organic growth +16% vs consensus +13%. Reported sales were in line and margin of 14.2% was 10bps above consensus 14.1%, a 1% beat. The orders beat came from Energy, while Marine was weaker on Equipment orders. Guidance is unchanged, with demand expected to stay stable at high levels over the next 12 months.

Allianz preview: Buy, PT EUR465 (10% upside). 3Q'26 results are due November 12. GS operating profit estimate is about 1% below company-collected consensus, with P&C -2% and Asset Management -2%, on a headline COR about 15bps less favourable and insurance revenue about 2% lower.

Orange: beat and raised EBITDA guide, with four quarters of beat and raise possible. Revenue €12.19B was a beat, with Spain 1.9% ahead and France 1.1% ahead. EBITDAaL was €4.14B (+4.6%), 0.9% above, and OFCF was 1% ahead on slightly higher capex.
Apple preview: Buy, PT USD390 (15% upside). GS expects in-line F4Q26 results: iPhone revenue +15% yoy, Services revenue +10% yoy, gross margin 47.8%.

market_movers.rationale: Gjensidige: pricing is expected to normalise as claims inflation moderates, and margin expansion should slow. FY27e-30e EPS is cut by about 2.4% on average.
GS expects in-line F4Q26 results with iPhone revenue +15% yoy, Services +10% yoy and gross margin of 47.8%. Implied upside is 15%.
Allianz: 3Q'26 operating profit estimate is about 1% below consensus, driven by P&C and Asset Management. Implied upside is 10%.

earnings_insights: Wartsila Q3 (reported 10/27): order growth +45% vs consensus +33%, organic growth +16% vs consensus +13%. Reported sales in line with consensus, margin 14.2% vs consensus 14.1%, a 1% beat. Energy drove the orders beat and Marine was weaker on Equipment orders. Guidance unchanged.
Orange (reported): revenue €12.19B ahead of expectations, with Spain 1.9% ahead and France 1.1% ahead. EBITDAaL €4.14B (+4.6%), 0.9% beat. OFCF 1% ahead. EBITDA guide raised.

Allianz 3Q'26 (reports 11/12, GS estimate): operating profit about 1% below company-collected consensus published 10/26, P&C -2% and Asset Management -2%. GS expects headline COR about 15bps less favourable and insurance revenue about 2% lower.
Apple F4Q26 (GS estimate, not yet reported): iPhone revenue +15% yoy, Services revenue +10% yoy, gross margin 47.8%, in line with expectations.
Gjensidige: GS cuts FY27e-30e EPS by about 2.4% on average on lower growth and margin expansion.
